from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.SharedMemory(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.MAZE_MEMORY_WORKER] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.MAZE_MEMORY_AGGREGATOR)
        seed = await star(problem)
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(worker_llm=self.llm, moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, agent_prompts=[prompt_custom.MAZE_DEBATE_AGENT_V3] * 3, moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.MAZE_DEBATE_MODERATOR_V3, n_rounds=2)
        solution = await debate(f"{problem}\n\nVerified maze summary / seed candidate:\n{seed.get('response', 'not exist the path from start to end.')}")
        final_response = solution.get("response") or "```text\nnot exist the path from start to end.\n```"
        return final_response, {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
